name: Avenio Department Store
description: A department-store Layout: a deals ticker, a department bar with five-column mega menus, an event band with department buttons, wide photo slides, deal rows, price-point tiles, brand tiles, a five-across listing with a filter drawer and colour prompt, and a two-column product page with size boxes, Add to bag + Buy now and pickup / delivery tiles. One wine-red colour family, crisp 4/8 px corners, DM Serif Display over Figtree.
